name: Zippuli (Italian Potato Cheese Fritters)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix together all ingredients but the potatoes and eggs.
Mash in the potatoes, and mix together into a crumbly paste.
Mix in the eggs until a sticky dough is made.
Roll dough into hotdog-sized logs about 6–8 inches long.
Fry in hot grease, turning once to get both sides brown. Drain on paper towels.

culture.text: Zippula is a fried dough made to a recipe from Calabria, Italy. Zippula is made with flour, water, yeast, boiled potatoes, and a pinch of salt. There are many variations: often anchovies are added, but salt cod, stockfish, cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, olives or 'nduja may also be added.
